SMART GUIDE · START HERE

Learn SPIKE World in seconds

New here? Pick a section below. Each one tells you what it does, what you need, and the exact steps to get started.

⚔ Battles

Challenge a friend, choose a topic, set the duration, then let the community vote. Tip: You cannot vote for yourself.

🔗 Signal Chains

Start an idea and let people build on it one response at a time. Setup: give it a title, optional description, then write the first link.

🎯 Community Missions

Create one shared goal, choose a fixed XP difficulty tier, then work toward SPIKE's server-defined target before the deadline. Progress must reflect a real contribution.

🏆 Seasons

Seasons turn World activity into a shared score. Your points are awarded by SPIKE from eligible activity — you do not manually claim points.

⭕ Circles

Create a private Circle for invited friends or a discoverable Circle anyone can join. Owners can invite friends; members can open the Circle chat.

SPIKE Battles

Challenge a friend. Everyone else can vote.

📖 Full Battle Guide · How it works

What is a Battle?

A friendly head-to-head challenge between two friends where eligible community members vote for the winner.

How to create one

  1. Choose a friend.
  2. Add a clear topic and optional context.
  3. Optionally connect a Signal.
  4. Choose the duration and launch.

Voting and winning

Community voters choose one side. Participants cannot vote in their own Battle. Votes are protected server-side and the Battle closes according to its rules.

Fair play

Do not coordinate fake accounts, spam voting, or attempt to manipulate the result. Repeated voting does not create unlimited progression.

Signal Chains

Build an idea one response at a time.

📖 Full Signal Chain Guide · How it works

What is a Signal Chain?

A connected sequence of ideas where each entry builds on the previous contribution.

How to start

  1. Give the Chain a title.
  2. Add an optional description.
  3. Optionally attach a root Signal.
  4. Write the first entry.

How to continue

Read the existing entries, then add a meaningful continuation. Entries keep their parent-child relationship so the history stays understandable.

Fair play

Useful contributions are the goal. Do not spam empty entries or create endless activity only for progression.

Community Missions

People join one target and move it forward together.

📖 Full Mission Guide · How it works

What is a Community Mission?

A shared challenge where members work toward one community goal before the deadline.

1. Create the mission

  1. Choose a clear title and explain the goal.
  2. Select one fixed XP difficulty tier.
  3. SPIKE sets the challenge target and time window for that tier.
  4. Publish only when the goal is clear and achievable.

2. XP is also difficulty

You do not type an XP amount. Higher XP means a harder mission. The server accepts only SPIKE-defined tiers.

3. Join and contribute

Join an active mission, then record progress when your contribution genuinely moves the shared goal forward. Progress and completion are checked by SPIKE's server.

4. Completion and reward

When the mission reaches its server-defined target, the eligible completion reward is awarded once. You cannot manually grant yourself XP or change the reward from the browser.

Fair play

Do not spam fake progress, automate clicks, create trivial high-tier challenges, or use multiple accounts to manufacture progression. SPIKE enforces reward tiers and mission difficulty on the server.

Your selected XP tier determines the mission difficulty, target and time window. These values are enforced by SPIKE.

SPIKE Seasons

One shared scoreboard across the World.

📖 Full Season Guide · How it works

What is a Season?

A limited-time competition that turns eligible SPIKE World activity into Season Points and a shared leaderboard.

Season Points vs XP

XP controls your normal SPIKE level. Season Points control your seasonal ranking. They are separate systems.

How to rank up

Participate in eligible World activities. SPIKE awards qualifying points on the server; you do not manually claim or enter points.

Fair play and limits

Season sources are controlled and reward caps limit repetitive farming. Manipulating the browser cannot directly award points.

SPIKE Circles

Small communities with their own conversation.

📖 Full Circle Guide · How it works

What is a Circle?

A community space for people who want an ongoing place to connect, talk and participate together.

Private vs discoverable

Private Circles are invitation-only. Discoverable Circles can be joined by eligible users.

How membership works

Owners can invite friends. Members can join, leave and open the Circle chat according to the Circle's rules.

Fair play

Circles are for real community. Do not spam messages or manufacture activity for progression. Community value comes first.
